title: Cosmic hero
description: Opening screen on the starfield: a very large title and a lead text, a side column for goals, a row of cards at the bottom, and the limb of a planet rising behind the cards with an orbital sunrise. Stacks on narrow screens.

slots.label: Side column
slots.description: Goals or a short key message.

slots.label: Cards
slots.description: Two to four stat cards (or short callouts) over the planet.
